name: GFX_hof_ic_smirnov_far_eastern_republic
title: 远东共和国
concept: One large striped wooden border post in foreground, a short wooden barrier and fence receding diagonally toward the RIGHT Pacific coastline, misty sea beyond. Tiny faceless sentry silhouette seen from behind at the boundary. Strong vertical border marker, boundary restraint rather than advance. Pale cyan-grey and ivory sculptural landscape, colder and later dusk.
prompt: Create ONE Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon matching reference outer frame and sculpted engraved relief finish but replace ALL central objects with this miniature landscape: One large striped wooden border post in foreground, a short wooden barrier and fence receding diagonally toward the RIGHT Pacific coastline, misty sea beyond. Tiny faceless sentry silhouette seen from behind at the boundary. Strong vertical border marker, boundary restraint rather than advance. Pale cyan-grey and ivory sculptural landscape, colder and later dusk. Use antique GOLD laurel branches open at top, small red star above and blank gold ribbon below, thin deep crimson medallion rim. Interior scene primarily ivory and grey bas-relief with restrained specified color tints; scene is an embossed miniature landscape, not a photograph. Retain some deep red around interior scene edges for series unity. Strong upper-left relief light and readable silhouettes at 100x88 pixels. No readable text, letters, numbers, watermark, faces or leader portraits. Landscape aspect 100:88, emblem fills 94% of canvas. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND ENABLED: RGBA PNG actual alpha=0 outside isolated emblem, four corners transparent, transparent area 20-50%. No checkerboard, no solid rectangle, no outer shadow.
